items.quote: Guys, that's only two reasons someone's going to think it's too expensive.
items.statement: Clients may think a product is too expensive for two reasons.

items.quote: or they don't have the money now. or they don't have the money in that amount.
items.statement: One reason for price objections is that clients may not have enough money.

items.quote: is not enough in the mind of the client to match the price.
items.statement: The perceived value of the offer may not match its price in the client's mind.

overview: Observations on client objections in sales regarding price and value perception.
